statement_pretty:
∀ {α : Type} [inst_2 : LinearOrder α] [inst_3 : SuccOrder α] {a b : α},
  a < Order.succ b → max (Order.succ b) (Order.succ a) = Order.succ b

editorial.unverified_gloss: In any linearly ordered type with a successor operation, if `a < succ b`, then `max (succ b) (succ a) = succ b`. The hypothesis `a < succ b` implies `a ≤ b`, which by monotonicity of `succ` gives `succ a ≤ succ b`, so the maximum is simply `succ b`. This is a routine consequence of the basic order properties of the successor function.
